actions: Launch a coordinated opt-in mobile order bundle offer for breakfast in the 15 consenting Dunkin franchise locations near the Starbucks pilot cafés, emphasizing a $6 breakfast Meal Deal with mobile ordering convenience during the 7–10 a.m. peak weekday window.
Implement a local marketing campaign in January 2027 promoting the value and convenience of the mobile order bundle, with a cap on combined promotion and staffing spend at $20,000 for the month.

Monitor basket contribution, repeat visits, and labor costs closely to evaluate profitability and customer retention, with a decision rule to discontinue or adjust the offer if economics worsen after one month.
expected_responses: Starbucks may intensify its focus on Smart Queue and café staffing to enhance mobile order throughput and customer experience during peak hours.
Dutch Bros may respond by promoting its drive-through and Order Ahead options to maintain share among morning beverage customers.
Some customers may shift from Starbucks mobile orders to Dunkin's value bundle if the offer is perceived as more convenient or cost-effective.
content.rationale: Dunkin's strength lies in its established franchise footprint and value-oriented coffee-and-food offerings, supported by a mobile app with ordering capabilities. With Starbucks piloting capacity-aware mobile pickup slots that reserve 20% of peak café capacity for mobile orders, Dunkin should respond by reinforcing its competitive advantage in value and convenience through a focused, locally controlled offer. This approach leverages Dunkin's existing app and franchise network, aligns with the $20,000 monthly promotional budget, and addresses the priority to secure a repeatable breakfast basket and predictable pickup experience. The opt-in nature respects franchisee autonomy and local market conditions.
resource_commitments: Allocate up to $20,000 in January 2027 for combined local promotion and staffing costs across the 15 participating franchise locations.
Dedicate staff time to manage and monitor the bundle offer performance, including basket contribution and repeat visits, on a weekly basis.
